description: This file is a Python script for handling email processing and CRM case management integration within OpenERP, including email parsing, case creation, and email sending functions.

classes.name: rpc_proxy
classes.description: A class for creating an XML-RPC proxy to communicate with the OpenERP server.

classes.name: email_parser
classes.description: A class for parsing emails, extracting content and attachments, and interacting with the CRM system.

methods.name: rpc_proxy.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the RPC proxy with server details and credentials.

methods.name: rpc_proxy.__call__
methods.description: Executes an RPC request to the server.

methods.name: email_parser.__init__
methods.description: Initializes email parser with user credentials, section, and server info.

methods.name: email_parser.email_get
methods.description: Extracts email address from a string.

methods.name: email_parser.partner_get
methods.description: Retrieves partner information based on email.

methods.name: email_parser.msg_new
methods.description: Creates a new CRM case from email message.

methods.name: email_parser.msg_body_get
methods.description: Extracts body and attachments from email message.

methods.name: email_parser.msg_user
methods.description: Updates a CRM case based on email commands.

methods.name: email_parser.msg_partner
methods.description: Opens a CRM case based on email message.

methods.name: email_parser.msg_test
methods.description: Tests for existing case by ID.

methods.name: email_parser.parse
methods.description: Main method to parse email and route to CRM case creation or update.
